description:
Pease Porridge Hot: Why Hot Cocoa Forms a Secret Skin on Top — Pease porridge hot, pease porridge cold! Ever notice that weird thin skin that forms on top of your warm hot cocoa?
Kids science answer for "hot cocoa science for kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

When warm milk or cocoa sits on the counter, water evaporates from the surface while milk proteins like casein and whey dry out and tangle together, forming a harmless rubbery film on top.
